clips.speaker: Jim Atkinson
clips.title: 韩妆刷屏不靠潮流：30年基建，才是底牌

subtitles.en: Most recently, as you know, there was a K-pop ETF that shut. Why did you pick cosmetics and specifically Korean cosmetics? Because the story is actually quite compelling. At the top line, there's 250 million social media mentions about K Beauty every week.
subtitles.zh: 最近，如你所知，有一只K-pop ETF关闭了。你为什么选择化妆品，特别是韩国化妆品？因为故事其实相当引人注目。首先，每周有2.5亿次社交媒体提及K Beauty。

subtitles.en: And when you take a look at it, you find out that there's a real amount of substance beneath the surface here.
subtitles.zh: 当你仔细看时，你会发现表面之下有实实在在的实质内容。

subtitles.en: Korea has been working on building the infrastructure behind K Beauty for over 30 years and it is growing extremely rapidly.
subtitles.zh: 韩国在K Beauty背后的基础设施建设上已经投入了30多年，而且增长极其迅速。

subtitles.en: It is entering other parts of the world. Korea is now the number two exporter into the United States of cosmetics and it's the number two exporter of cosmetics worldwide.
subtitles.zh: 它正在进入世界其他地区。韩国现在是美国第二大化妆品出口国，也是全球第二大化妆品出口国。

subtitles.en: And the numbers are actually quite phenomenal. And it's all because there's this infrastructure that Korea has been building for over 30 years.
subtitles.zh: 数字实际上相当惊人。这一切都是因为韩国30多年来一直在建设的基础设施。

subtitles.en: And if you look, there's a lot of excitement about it from the people that know what's going on.
subtitles.zh: 如果你观察一下，了解内情的人对此非常兴奋。
en_highlights: people that know what's going on

subtitles.en: And there's a lot of people that don't know what's going on. And that gives us an opportunity here because there's a great runway both in the United States and globally for K Beauty products.
subtitles.zh: 而很多人并不了解情况。这给了我们机会，因为K Beauty产品在美国和全球都有很大的发展空间。

subtitles.en: And where is the real money when it comes to K Beauty then, Jim? Is it the brands? Is it manufacturers? Is the aesthetic companies?
subtitles.zh: 那么，Jim，K Beauty的真正价值在哪里？是品牌？制造商？还是美容公司？

subtitles.en: And how do you kind of look at this sort of space here right now? And really, is it more about just chasing retail trends?
subtitles.zh: 你现在如何看待这个领域？真的只是追逐零售趋势吗？

subtitles.en: Or do you think this really is a long lasting sort of theme here for, of course, investors to get some returns on?
subtitles.zh: 或者你认为这确实是一个长期主题，当然，市场参与者可以从中获得一些回报？

subtitles.en: It's not just a trend. I mean, the products are safe, they're effective, and they're cheaper. And they do a real job for a lot of people.
subtitles.zh: 这不仅是趋势。产品安全有效，而且更便宜。它们为很多人解决了实际问题。

subtitles.en: But to answer your question, it are fun to invest in the entire ecosystem. And that's the manufacturers, the aesthetics companies and the brands.
subtitles.zh: 但回答你的问题，整个生态系统都值得配置。包括制造商、美容公司和品牌。

subtitles.en: The brands have a little bit of a problem, the smaller ones, because it's just, it's easy to enter the industry. And there's a competition problem.
subtitles.zh: 品牌有点问题，小品牌尤其如此，因为进入行业很容易，竞争问题突出。

subtitles.en: But if you look at the whole ecosystem, particularly the bigger brands, the manufacturers, the aesthetic companies, they've all got a huge advantage. And they're able to exploit that. And like I said, they're runway globally as massive.
subtitles.zh: 但纵观整个生态系统，尤其是大品牌、制造商和美容公司，它们都有巨大优势并能加以利用。正如我所说，全球增长空间巨大。

clips.speaker: Jim Atkinson
clips.title: Guinness Atkinson CEO：首只被动ETF押注韩妆，零售热情为何高涨？

subtitles.en: But if you look at the whole ecosystem, particularly the bigger brands, the manufacturers, the aesthetic companies, they've all got a huge advantage. And they're able to exploit that. And like I said, they're runway globally as massive.
subtitles.zh: 但纵观整个生态，尤其是大品牌、制造商、美妆公司，它们都有巨大优势，并能加以利用。如我所说，全球增长空间巨大。

subtitles.en: So Jim, this marks your six ETF into your mention. This is your first passive ETF. Where do you see investors to man across all of your ETFs? And are you seeing an increase in active ETFs?
subtitles.zh: Jim，这是你提到的第六只ETF，也是首只被动型ETF。你认为市场参与者会如何配置你的ETF？主动型ETF需求在增长吗？

subtitles.en: Active ETFs are very popular. The reason we decided to do this passive was because we didn't think we had the expertise to go manage this or the manpower.
subtitles.zh: 主动型ETF很受欢迎。我们选择被动型，是因为自认缺乏管理专长或人力。

subtitles.en: So we said, well, hang on. We want to get this product in the marketplace. We really love the story. We've done the research. How do we sort of get this out there? And we felt passive was the way to go here.
subtitles.zh: 我们想把这个产品推向市场，看好这个主题，也做了研究。如何推出？我们认为被动型是合适路径。

subtitles.en: And then in terms of your client base, where do you think you'll see the most demand for this product?
subtitles.zh: 就客户基础而言，你认为该产品最大需求来自哪里？

subtitles.en: Initially, it's going to be retail. The retail excitement around this idea is quite large. And I'll just give you an example.
subtitles.zh: 初期主要是零售端。零售市场参与者对这个主题热情很高，我举个例子。

subtitles.en: Our number one most traffic page on our website is our KBTY page by far. And that's been building for weeks heading up in the launch. And today our traffic was greater than it's ever been.
subtitles.zh: 我们网站流量最高的页面是KBTY页面，遥遥领先。数周来流量持续上升，今日流量创历史新高。

subtitles.en: And that's because people are very excited about this story.
subtitles.zh: 这是因为人们对该主题非常兴奋。

subtitles.en: Yeah, I mean, obviously there's there's there's K pop and then there's there's K beauty. I mean, is there any any sort of risk to this whole K beauty sort of story? You think Jim?
subtitles.zh: 有K-pop也有K-beauty。Jim，你认为整个K-beauty主题是否存在风险？

subtitles.en: Well, I understand the question. You can say anything in fashion is a trend, right? But if you look at what's actually going on underneath the surface in this industry, they have built a real large amount of infrastructure.
subtitles.zh: 我理解这个问题。时尚界一切皆趋势，但若看行业底层，它们已建立大量基础设施。

subtitles.en: And I'll give you an example. They passed a cosmetics act in 1999. And that said, you've got to have safe and effective ingredients in your products. And then a whole infrastructure built around that.
subtitles.zh: 我举个例子。他们在1999年通过了化妆品法案，规定产品成分必须安全有效，并围绕此建立了整套体系。

subtitles.en: So what you end up with is safe and effective products that are cheaper than what you might get from other cosmetic companies. And the whole thing is just taken off virally on social media.
subtitles.zh: 最终你得到的是安全有效的产品，价格还比其他化妆品公司便宜。整个事情在社交媒体上病毒式传播。

subtitles.en: And now that is starting to move into the stores here in the United States. But it's also in Europe, Latin America, India.
subtitles.zh: 现在这开始进入美国门店，也拓展到欧洲、拉美和印度。
en_highlights: stores here in the United States

subtitles.en: I mean, this is a very popular product line industry. And it's got a lot of runway to go.
subtitles.zh: 这是一个非常受欢迎的产品线行业，还有很大的增长空间。

clips.speaker: Wei Shan
clips.title: 高盛闪辉地产还在调整：拖累却要变小，明年增长靠什么？
title_lines: 高盛闪辉地产还在调整

subtitles.en: So as investors, it's just another set of uncertainties to navigate. Your report, less drag more uncertainty, walk us through that sort of headline of what are you expecting for next year for growth for China.
subtitles.zh: 所以对市场参与者来说，这不过是另一组需要应对的不确定性。你们的报告标题是“拖累减少，不确定性增加”，请带我们了解一下，你们对明年中国增长的主要预期是什么。

subtitles.en: So as you said, we're expecting pretty much a similar pace of growth next year.
subtitles.zh: 正如你所说，我们预计明年的增长速度与今年大致相似。

subtitles.en: Now, there's a little math behind it as I was getting a bit wonky, but what we are really trying to emphasize is that focus on the second derivative.
subtitles.zh: 这背后有一些数学计算，我有点过于技术化了，但我们真正想强调的是关注二阶导数。

subtitles.en: What that means is that yes, property is very weak and probably continue to decline, but the magnitude of decline next year should be smaller than this year.
subtitles.zh: 这意味着，是的，地产市场非常疲软，可能还会继续下行，但明年下行的幅度应该小于今年。

subtitles.en: Same thing with the fiscal tightening. There's a whole year if you look at China's tax collection up, government expenditure down, that's the fiscal tightening, fiscal consolidation, right?
subtitles.zh: 财政紧缩也是同样的情况。如果你看中国全年税收增加、政府支出下降，那就是财政紧缩、财政整顿，对吧？

subtitles.en: So we expect to continue to tight fiscal policy, but you're not going to see this big, ginormous step in tightening, the pace will slow.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们预计财政政策将继续偏紧，但不会看到大幅度的紧缩步伐，节奏会放缓。

subtitles.en: So the second derivative is the turning positive. In other words, if this year fiscal policy subtracted growth, let's say by one percent of the next year is a half a percent, that's a positive on the sequential basis.
subtitles.zh: 所以二阶导数正在转正。换句话说，如果今年财政政策拖累增长，比如一个百分点，明年是半个百分点，那在环比基础上就是正向的。

subtitles.en: So if you're thinking for and a half for next year, I mean, do you still see any sort of urgency from policy makers to inject sort of any stimulus at this point, or are they still going to expect the pillars like exports to continue things for?
subtitles.zh: 所以如果你考虑明年增长4.5%，我的意思是，你认为政策制定者现在还有紧迫感去注入刺激措施吗，还是他们仍然指望出口等支柱继续支撑？

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
